context: Ren and Mei recall a trip where things went wrong.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (無かっ/ちゃい/何とか/余裕/遠く) in natural home.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: あの旅行、電車が無かったよね。
lines.en: On that trip, there were no trains.
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle amused delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うん、最終に乗り遅れちゃった。
lines.en: Yeah, we missed the last one.
lines.style: rueful young man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 遠くまで、歩く羽目になったね。
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm reminiscing delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 何とか、宿には着いたよね。
lines.en: We somehow made it to the inn.
lines.style: relieved young man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 時間に余裕が、全然無かったの。
lines.en: We had no time to spare at all.
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 君が真剣に地図を見てて、驚いたよ。
lines.en: I was surprised how seriously you read the map.
lines.style: warm young man voice, soft warm fond delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: あの驚きの旅、また話そうね。
lines.en: Let's talk about that surprising trip again.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm affectionate delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 今思えば、余裕を持つべきだったね。
lines.en: Looking back, we should've left more room.
lines.style: reflective young man voice, soft warm closing delivery throughout
